font.family_role: sole Hangul source for all builds created after this policy

render_profile.placement: centre native ink in the 12x12 cell; an 8x8 glyph starts at x=2,y=2
render_profile.bit_order: two bytes per row, MSB first

historical_exception: Older Galmuri11-based diagnostic builders and their locked outputs remain only for reproduction of past PASS/FAIL evidence. They are prohibited as inputs to new patch builds.
enforcement: Every new builder must verify the font SHA-256 before rendering.
Missing glyphs or ink larger than 12x12 must fail the build.
Task 3 and later active builders must record the font path, hash, and render profile in their manifests.
